name: Black Ops 3 Base and Cut Camos
teaser: Base camos and cut camos found in game files
description_html:
Black Ops 3 Camos including Single Player, Zombies, Multiplayer, Supply Drops and cut camos that I found while looking thru files. There are a few camos missing (I Will add When I can). All the camos have been upscaled to look nice. From what I’ve seen they all look good in game. There’s a total of 191 camos. You can download the whole pack or I also have them separate on github.

CAMOS INCLUDED:
